body.label: Target
body.html: Up to three enemies within ranged Weapon Range and a cone of length 5.

body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, each target takes 1 weapon Damage.

surges.html: Choose one target to ignore 1 point of cover bonus against.
Each hit target is Slowed 1 until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Lock - Salvo
rider.html: After resolving, choose a hit target. You may transfer your Lock to it; the other hit targets cannot provide it cover against your next Ballistics Action until the start of your next turn.
